question: Will NVDA stock be lower on Dec 31, 2026 than it is on Oct 2, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the official Nasdaq closing price of NVDA on December 31, 2026 (at or before 2026-12-31T21:00:00Z) is strictly lower than the official Nasdaq closing price of NVDA on October 2, 2026 (strictly after 2026-10-02T17:09:14.213Z and at or before 2026-12-31T21:00:00Z).
- "No": Wins if the official Nasdaq closing price of NVDA on December 31, 2026 (at or before 2026-12-31T21:00:00Z) is equal to or higher than the official Nasdaq closing price of NVDA on October 2, 2026 (strictly after 2026-10-02T17:09:14.213Z and at or before 2026-12-31T21:00:00Z).

Clarifications:
- The reference price for October 2, 2026 is the official Nasdaq regular-session closing price for NVDA on that date. The reference price for December 31, 2026 is the official Nasdaq regular-session closing price for NVDA on that date. If either date is not a regular Nasdaq trading session, the most recent prior regular-session closing price is used.
